verdict.rationale: Puzzle's 'AI Close' explicitly automates month-end reconciliation, transaction review, and discrepancy surfacing, and separate docs cover bank reconciliation, cash/accrual accounting, and journal entry adjustments — core close mechanics are evidenced. However, there is no mention of a structured checklist UI or explicit reviewer sign-off/approval workflow tying these steps together into a trackable close process. Missing for 10: dedicated checklist/task-tracking view, explicit sign-off/approval audit trail for reviewers.
